create_experiment_clock: create an ExperimentClock instance to get the current simulation time via get_time
start_clock_controller: create a ClockController and call start with a start_time to begin the simulation clock
set_clock_time: use ClockController set_time to set the current time and optionally start running the clock
tick_clock_forward: use ClockController tick to advance the simulation clock forward by a specified increment
set_realtime_factor: use ClockController set_realtime_factor to adjust the clock speed while preserving paused or running state
